name: Crossref REST API
summary: Bibliographic metadata for scholarly works registered with Crossref DOIs: titles, authors, references, funders, licenses and citation counts.
description: Crossref is the DOI registration agency for most journals, books and conference papers, and exposes deposited metadata via a keyless REST API. You can search and filter works, journals, funders, members, prefixes and licenses, with cursor-based deep paging. Adding a mailto parameter or a contact in the User-Agent routes requests to a faster polite pool.

auth.notes: No key needed. Optionally pass mailto=<email> or put a mailto in the User-Agent to use the polite pool; paid Metadata Plus is not required.

rate_limit.summary: Public pool about 5 req/s; polite pool about 10 req/s plus concurrency caps; see x-rate-limit headers. Numbers have changed recently, verify in docs.

license.name: Metadata is freely reusable (CC0 intent); some fields such as abstracts and license links vary

coverage.temporal: Continuously updated; about 188.7M works at check

agent_notes: Include a mailto in the User-Agent or query to get the polite pool. select= works only on list routes (400 on /works/{doi}). Use cursor=* for deep paging.
caveats: Relevance ranking for bibliographic queries is fuzzy; verify the DOI by title.
Rate numbers should be re-checked against the docs; they changed in 2025-26.
The HN reference is a Show HN story where Crossref staff recommended the API in comments, not a dedicated story.
